name: watch-x
description: Cross-platform CPU, GPU, memory, temperature and fan monitor
author: zheng

scripts.build:spd-helper: dotnet publish -c Release helpers/spd-helper/SpdHelper.csproj -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o helpers/spd-helper/dist
scripts.test:spd: dotnet test helpers/spd-helper/tests/SpdHelper.Tests.csproj --nologo && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-ddr5-spd-decode.mts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-ddr5-spd-profiles.mts && npx tsx scripts/test-dram-db.mts
scripts.dist: npm run icons && npm run fetch:vendor && npm run build:spd-helper && vite build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run icons && npm run fetch:vendor && npm run build:spd-helper && vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icons && vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: npm run icons && vite build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.pack:dir: npm run icons && npm run fetch:vendor && npm run build:spd-helper && vite build && electron-builder --dir
